title: Career
description: A job on the career template (D9): where it is worked, what it pays, the shifts its employer runs and posts, how standing moves, how long its skill takes to learn, and which shift events it draws.

place.description: The kind of building on your block it is worked in, when it is walkable there (the diner). Without one, it is worked off screen at its employer's lot (D73).

insurance.description: Whether the employer offers health cover to its full-time staff (M2.7, D105). Traced in CALIBRATION.md.

wage.description: Cents an hour, before tax. Traced in CALIBRATION.md.

employers.description: Where it is worked in the city, and how often its staff leave (D74).

districts.description: The districts its employers stand in.

staff.description: People in this career at one employer (tune). 0 for a rank reached only by promotion, which has no openings of its own.

turnover.description: Separations a month per thousand staff, from its industry's federal turnover survey. Traced in CALIBRATION.md.

share.description: Jobs in this career per ten thousand in the city: how often a tier-1 workplace works it. 0 for a rank reached only by promotion. Traced in CALIBRATION.md.

requires.description: What hiring asks beyond being 18 (D75). Traced in CALIBRATION.md.

record.description: none: no conviction at all; no-theft: none for theft or dishonesty; no-felony: no felony (MCOLES's standard for a police licence). A no-felony job is lost on a felony sentence.

hiring.description: The odds an application is taken (D74), shown first and rolled: the base, less points with a conviction, and points either way from your reputation.

record.description: Taken when you have a conviction it doesn't bar.

reputation.description: Added at full reputation, taken at none.

shifts.description: The shifts it runs on every day it is open, by when they start and how long they last.

open.description: The days it runs its shifts.

posting.description: The day next week's shifts go up, Monday to Sunday, and how many you're offered: the fewest at standing 0, the most at 100, one a day.

perWeek.label: Shifts a week
perWeek.description: The most shifts you may take from Monday to Sunday.

pay.description: Payday, once a week, for every minute worked since the last.

withholding.description: The taxes the employer withholds from pay (D38).

standing.description: How standing moves, from 0 to 100 (D39, tune). At 0 you're let go.

shift.description: Added for a whole shift worked on time.

lateAfter.label: Late after
lateAfter.description: Minutes after a shift's start that still count as on time.

late.description: Taken for starting later than that.

missedAfter.label: Missed after
missedAfter.description: Minutes of a shift that can go unworked, once you're there, before it counts as leaving early.

dropBefore.label: Drop before
dropBefore.description: Minutes before its start that a shift can still be dropped.

letGoAt.label: Let go at
letGoAt.description: Warnings at once that end the job.

skill.description: Skill grows with practice, every minute worked and some outcomes, and comes more slowly the more there is: 100 × practice ÷ (practice + half).

half.description: Minutes of practice to reach half skill.

crew.description: Who works beside you (D41): for now one, the other cook, drawn from the seed.

asks.description: Percent of days they ask you to cover a shift.

cover.description: The odds they cover a shift you ask them to (D43): the base, and regard's points.

half.description: Minutes beside them for familiarity to reach half.

acts.description: What they remember of what you do: late, or not there, on a shift of theirs; covering one of theirs, saying no, or never answering; asking them to cover yours.

ladder.description: The rank it leads to (M2.4): reached on a shift worked once practice and standing are enough, with the same employer.

practice.description: Minutes of practice in this career.
